📺 Maid (2021)

Maid follows Alex Russell, a young single mother who escapes an emotionally abusive relationship with her boyfriend, Sean, determined to create a safer and better life for herself and her two-year-old daughter, Maddy. With little money, limited resources, and nowhere permanent to live, Alex begins working as a house cleaner while struggling to navigate poverty, homelessness, and a complicated government assistance system. Her journey becomes even more challenging as she deals with her unpredictable mother, Paula, unresolved childhood trauma, and a difficult custody battle. Despite countless setbacks and exhausting working conditions, Alex refuses to abandon her dreams of becoming a writer and providing her daughter with a brighter future. Starring Margaret Qualley, Andie MacDowell, and Nick Robinson, the series delivers deeply emotional performances and powerful storytelling while exploring motherhood, domestic abuse, economic inequality, resilience, independence, and the extraordinary determination it takes to rebuild your life from nothing.

🎭 Genre: Drama • Social Drama

⭐ IMDb: 8.3/10

⏱️ Runtime: Approximately 50–60 minutes per episode • TV-MA

🎥 Creator: Molly Smith Metzler

📺 Seasons: 1 • 10 Episodes

📚 Based On: Stephanie Land’s memoir Maid: Hard Work, Low Pay, and a Mother’s Will to Survive.

📍 Setting: Washington State.

🏆 Recognition: Received multiple Primetime Emmy and Golden Globe Award nominations.

📺 Where to Watch: Netflix.

source_details.synopsis: Maid is an American drama limited series created for Netflix by Molly Smith Metzler. The series is inspired by Stephanie Land's memoir Maid: Hard Work, Low Pay, and a Mother's Will to Survive. Its story focuses on a young mother who escapes an abusive relationship and struggles to provide for her daughter by getting a job cleaning houses. It premiered on Netflix on October 1, 2021. Maid became Netflix's fourth-most-watched show of the year. Its accolades include three Primetime Emmy Award nominations, including an acting nomination for Margaret Qualley, and three Golden Globe nominations.
